findings.check: K=R=C_3, R+=O_C3, r=1, A=1+3T. Inverse is convergent geometric series. All Laurent polynomial units cT^n. Distance >=1/3 if n=0, >=1 otherwise. Thus no density, with all affinoid-perfectoid hypotheses satisfied.

focused_acceptance.reason: On PDF page 39 the proof explicitly asserts density of GL_r(R[T^{+/-1}]) in GL_r(R<T^{+/-1}>). Take the permitted affinoid perfectoid field R=K=C_3, R+=O_C3, r=1 and A=1+3T. It is analytically invertible, whereas Laurent-polynomial units are cT^n; the Gauss distance is at least 1/3 for n=0 and at least 1 otherwise. This proves the written density premise false. It feeds Lemma 8.2.9, finite presentation, P1 and curve GAGA, and the Higgs comparison, so Major remains appropriate. The exact lemma is restored, conditional on Lemma 8.2.5, by a Laurent matrix P invertible only analytically, with P^-1 A in U; factor that small term as A+ A- and use PA+, which has bounded negative powers. Repairability does not remove the invalid core derivation.

focused_acceptance.reason: The unrestricted introduction Theorem 1.4.1 calls psi an isomorphism. Over C_3, the smooth genus-two completion of y^2=x^5-x with GL2 and Hitchin point (0,0) has nonreduced spectral equation t^2=0. The Hodge-Tate source dimension is h^1(O)+h^0(Omega) plus h^1(Omega^-1)+h^0(O), namely 4+4=8, while nilpotent invariance of etale cohomology gives the target dimension 2g=4. All printed curve/group/base assumptions hold. Theorem 7.0.1, its Cartesian assertion and Remark 7.0.5 already use the weaker comparison morphism and allow failure of isomorphism; the kernel isomorphism suffices in the body. Minor is the introductory overstatement, with no new main-body failure.

focused_acceptance.reason: Section 5.5 omits a genus restriction for its dense smooth connected spectral locus. For rank 2 on P1 the Hitchin base is the point zero and t^2=0 is nonreduced. For an elliptic curve distinct constant roots give a disconnected cover, while repeated roots give a nonreduced one. Later principal statements already require genus>=2, and rank one is separate. These are complete boundary counterexamples to the unrestricted local assertion and support Minor, without refuting the later scoped applications.
